name: Blixeprodil
summary: Blixeprodil (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known by its developmental code name GM-1020 or as (R)-4-fluorodeschloroketamine ((R)-4-FDCK), is an NMDA receptor antagonist related to ketamine which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, bipolar depression, and other depressive disorders. It is taken orally.
